cues.en: So I was in a high state of enthusiasm,
cues.zh: 所以我当时兴致很高，

cues.en: and
cues.zh: 于是

cues.en: I decided I would go to Chicago and show these results to Fermi
cues.zh: 决定去芝加哥，把这些结果展示给 Fermi 看，

cues.en: and
cues.zh: 并且

cues.en: tell him how well we were doing.
cues.zh: 告诉他我们的进展有多好。

cues.en: We wanted to have Fermi's blessing on our efforts, as he was the
cues.zh: 我们希望 Fermi 能认可我们的努力，因为他是

cues.en: prime mover in
cues.zh: 整个领域的

cues.en: this whole subject.
cues.zh: 主要推动者。

cues.en: And it was a good opportunity for me to get to know Fermi. So anyway, I arranged through Hans Bethe
cues.zh: 而且这也是个好机会，让我认识 Fermi。于是，我通过 Hans Bethe 安排好行程，

cues.en: to go to Chicago and tell him about what we've been doing.
cues.zh: 前往芝加哥，向他介绍我们一直在做的事。

cues.en: So I arrived at Chicago
cues.zh: 于是我到了芝加哥，

cues.en: and knocked on Fermi's door, and he was very polite.
cues.zh: 敲了敲 Fermi 的门。他非常客气。

cues.en: I came in and he said yes, and I showed him the graphs
cues.zh: 我走进去，他答应了，于是我把图表拿给他看，

cues.en: on which our theoretical
cues.zh: 上面绘制了我们的理论计算

cues.en: numbers were plotted and Fermi's experimental numbers were plotted,
cues.zh: 数据，以及 Fermi 的实验数据，

cues.en: and the agreement was on the whole pretty good.
cues.zh: 总体上吻合得相当好。

cues.en: So Fermi
cues.zh: 但 Fermi

cues.en: hardly looked at these graphs.
cues.zh: 几乎没怎么看这些图表。

cues.en: He just put them on the desk,
cues.zh: 他只是随手放在桌上，

cues.en: just glanced at them very briefly, and he said:
cues.zh: 草草扫了一眼，然后说道：

cues.en: I'm not very impressed with what you've been doing.
cues.zh: 你们做的这些东西，并没有让我觉得有多深刻。

cues.en: And he said:
cues.zh: 他又说：

cues.en: When one does a theoretical calculation, you know, there are two ways of doing it: either you should have a
cues.zh: 你知道，做理论计算通常有两种方式：要么心里要有一个

cues.en: clear physical model in mind,
cues.zh: 清晰的物理模型，

cues.en: or you should have a rigorous mathematical basis.
cues.zh: 要么就得有严谨的数学基础。

cues.en: You have neither.
cues.zh: 你两者都没有。

cues.en: So that was it. In about two sentences he disposed of the whole subject.
cues.zh: 就这么回事。他大约两句话就把整个话题打发了。

cues.en: Well, then I asked him, well, what does he think about the numerical agreement? And he said,
cues.zh: 后来我就问他，那他怎么看数值一致性？他说，

cues.en: How many parameters did you use for the fit, and
cues.zh: 你在拟合时用了多少个参数，并且

cues.en: how many free parameters are there in
cues.zh: 有多少个自由参数

cues.en: your method?
cues.zh: 你的方法呢？

cues.en: So I counted up. It turned out there were four.
cues.zh: 我数了一下，结果发现只有四个。

cues.en: Said: You know, Jonathan Neumann always used to say,
cues.zh: Said：你知道，Jonathan Neumann 总是这么说，

cues.en: with four parameters I can fit an elephant,
cues.zh: 用四个参数我能拟合出一头大象，

cues.en: and with five I can make him wiggle his trunk.
cues.zh: 而用五根手指，我就能让他甩动鼻子。

cues.en: So I don't find the numerical agreement very impressive either.
cues.zh: 所以我觉得这个数值吻合也不怎么令人信服。

cues.en: So I said, well, thank you very much for your help, and I said goodbye. There was nothing more to be said, so the whole discussion took maybe ten or fifteen minutes.
cues.zh: 我就说：“好，非常感谢你的帮助。”然后告辞了。也没什么可说的了，所以整场讨论大概只花了十到十五分钟。

cues.en: So I came back to Cornell to tell the team the bad news.
cues.zh: 于是我回到康奈尔，告诉团队这个坏消息。

cues.en: So that was another watershed in my life,
cues.zh: 所以，那是我人生中的又一个转折点，

cues.en: and I think it was profoundly useful what Fermi did. He had this amazing intuition. He could spot
cues.zh: 我觉得费米的做法非常有用。他的直觉惊人，总能立刻看出

cues.en: what was good and what was bad right away. I mean, we might have worked on these calculations for five years
cues.zh: 什么好、什么不好。我是说，要不是费米，

cues.en: if Fermi hadn't
cues.zh: 我们可能会在这些计算上花五年时间，

cues.en: given us the red light.
cues.zh: 而他给我们亮了红灯。

cues.en: As it was,
cues.zh: 事实证明，

cues.en: Fermi was absolutely right, because in the end, of course, it turned out the theory on which we based the whole calculation
cues.zh: Fermi 是完全正确的，因为最终事实表明，我们整个计算所基于的理论

cues.en: was an illusion. There is really no such thing as a
cues.zh: 只是一种假象。根本就没有所谓的

cues.en: pseudo scalar theory of pions,
cues.zh: π 介子赝标量理论，

cues.en: that in reality,
cues.zh: 而实际上，

cues.en: ten years later or whenever it was,
cues.zh: 在十年后或是之后的某个时候，

cues.en: quarks were invented,
cues.zh: 夸克理论被提出来了，

cues.en: and the whole theory of the strong interactions was totally transformed
cues.zh: 整个强相互作用理论被彻底重塑

cues.en: into a theory of quarks. It's only when you represent the pion as a
cues.zh: 成了夸克理论。只有当你把 π 介子表示为

cues.en: compound system of two quarks
cues.zh: 由两个夸克组成的复合系统时，

cues.en: that you can begin to have a real physical theory.
cues.zh: 才算真正建立起一个符合实际的物理理论。

cues.en: So our whole
cues.zh: 所以我们的整个

cues.en: physical basis was wrong.
cues.zh: 物理基础都错了。

cues.en: So it was perfectly true that
cues.zh: 所以完全没错的是

cues.en: any experimental agreement we found was illusory.
cues.zh: 我们找到的任何实验吻合都是假象。

cues.en: But it took Fermi to see that,
cues.zh: 但只有费米看出来了，

cues.en: and he could see it without knowing about quarks. Of course, nobody had dreamed of quarks at that time.
cues.zh: 而且他不需要了解夸克就能看出来。当然，那时候还没人想到过夸克。

cues.en: But he felt in his bones that this theory was no good,
cues.zh: 但他骨子里觉得这个理论不行，

cues.en: and he was right.
cues.zh: 他是对的。

cues.en: So he saved us maybe five years of blind work, so
cues.zh: 所以他大概帮我们省了五年盲目摸索的时间，所以

cues.en: I'm
cues.zh: 我

cues.en: extremely grateful to him for that.
cues.zh: 对此非常感激他。

cues.en: But it was a tough
cues.zh: 但这对我们来说是个艰难的

cues.en: situation for us, especially because we had some graduate students involved in this project.
cues.zh: 局面，尤其是因为有几名研究生参与了这个项目。

cues.en: They depended on it for their PhD thesis.
cues.zh: 他们的博士论文都依赖这个项目。

cues.en: So it was difficult. Mean, I simply had to tell the team, Look, I'm sorry, but this is not going anywhere.
cues.zh: 所以这很难办。我只能跟团队说：“听着，很抱歉，但这件事已经走不下去了。”

cues.en: All
cues.zh: 我们

cues.en: we can do is write up what we've done and publish it,
cues.zh: 能做的就是把已经完成的工作整理成文并发表，

cues.en: but it's not going to go any further.
cues.zh: 但项目不会再有进展了。

cues.en: And you better find some other line of work.
cues.zh: 你们最好另找研究方向。

cues.en: So it was not a very pleasant
cues.zh: 所以这对研究生和我来说都不是一段愉快的

cues.en: experience for the graduate students or for me.
cues.zh: 经历。

cues.en: But in the end, of course, it was for the good of us all.
cues.zh: 但归根结底，这当然对我们大家都有好处。

cues.en: But that's the kind of
cues.zh: 但 Fermi 就是拥有

cues.en: genius that Fermi had, and I think
cues.zh: 那样的天才，我觉得

cues.en: That showed me very clearly that I wasn't a particle physicist, that
cues.zh: 这让我非常清楚地意识到，自己不是个粒子物理学家，

cues.en: I didn't have that kind of instincts. My
cues.zh: 我没有那种直觉。我的

cues.en: gifts are in mathematics and not basically in physics.
cues.zh: 天赋在于数学，从根本上说并不在物理。

cues.en: So
cues.zh: 所以，

cues.en: when there is a theory that is well based on physics,
cues.zh: 当有了一个物理基础扎实的理论时，

cues.en: as it was in the case of quantum electrodynamics,
cues.zh: 就像当年的量子电动力学那样，

cues.en: then I can do marvelously well with using it, but I am not able to invent a new theory.
cues.zh: 那我运用起来可以得心应手，但我没能力去开创一个新理论。

cues.en: What was required for the strong interactions
cues.zh: 强相互作用所必需的条件是什么

cues.en: was an invention,
cues.zh: 曾是一项发明，

cues.en: and that clearly wasn't
cues.zh: 显然不是这样

cues.en: my cup of tea. So from that time on I
cues.zh: 对我的胃口。所以从那时起，我

cues.en: didn't seriously try to
cues.zh: 没有认真尝试

cues.en: solve the problem of strong interactions.
cues.zh: 解决强相互作用的问题。

cues.en: From that time on I worked in field theory
cues.zh: 从那时起，我就研究场论了

cues.en: on the mathematical side, which I could do very happily
cues.zh: 在数学方面，我非常乐意去做

cues.en: and even usefully.
cues.zh: 甚至还能派上用场。

cues.en: So from that time on I was interested in the mathematics of field theory,
cues.zh: 所以从那时起，我就对场论的数学产生了兴趣，

cues.en: and I got
cues.zh: 于是我得到了

cues.en: involved in the Whiteman program of
cues.zh: 参与了怀特曼项目（Whiteman program）的

cues.en: trying to establish
cues.zh: 试图建立

cues.en: quantum field theory axiomatically,
cues.zh: 量子场论的公理化理论，

cues.en: and deducing from axioms
cues.zh: 并从公理中推导出来

cues.en: physical consequences.
cues.zh: 物理上的后果。

cues.en: That's something that I love to do, which is, in Fermi's terminology,
cues.zh: 这是我很喜欢做的一件事，用费米的说法，

cues.en: that's based on a firm mathematical basis.
cues.zh: 就是建立在坚实的数学基础上。

cues.en: Whether it's physically
cues.zh: 它在物理上是否

cues.en: correct or not, it's certainly mathematically sound.
cues.zh: 正确另说，但在数学上肯定是严谨的。

cues.en: So I made that choice that I would go with the mathematics and not with the physics.
cues.zh: 所以我决定遵循数学，而不是物理。
